name: Shekati
subtitle: Cheque register & due dates
description:
Record incoming and outgoing cheques, see their due dates and keep your cheque images together.

The free plan includes one bank account, ten active cheques, manual entry, a calendar and reminders.

Shekati Plus adds more accounts, unlimited active cheques, cheque scanning, endorsements, partial settlements, replacements and cash flow forecasts.

Choose a monthly or annual subscription. Your local price is shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your Apple Account.

You can read, close and export existing cheques after a subscription ends.
